scope: Completed focused source correction with passing regression evidence; awaiting protected integration, not a complete platform audit or release approval

invariants.statement: One legacy refund request can grant at most one Stripe POST permit, committed before provider IO. Uncertain outcomes never reopen pending.
assumptions: Normal writers preserve processing; no manual reset, stale database restore or old serving binary
The transport does not independently retry POSTs

invariants.statement: A stale rejection cannot overwrite a committed execution intent; its transaction must roll back.
assumptions: READ COMMITTED PostgreSQL conditional UPDATE rechecks the current row after lock wait

backlog.title: Legacy Stripe refunds permit duplicate POSTs after concurrent approvals or ambiguous response
Legacy Stripe partial refunds retire every ticket and release full order inventory
backlog.evidence: approveRefund accepts a positive amount below the paid total but applies the same whole-order projection for every parsed refund ID
backlog.nextStep: Reproduce actual-handler partial refund and specify ticket allocation before replacing the historical projection

backlog.title: Legacy Stripe approval treats a parsed refund ID as completion evidence
backlog.evidence: parseStripeRefundResponse checks only id; approveRefund marks approved/refunded without matching status, amount, currency or original PaymentIntent
backlog.nextStep: Add provider-shape counterexamples and durable bound-ID query/reconciliation; never re-POST a held request

backlog.title: Concurrent legacy request creation can create distinct requests for one order
backlog.evidence: Legacy requestRefund uses SELECT followed by INSERT without an identified per-order uniqueness constraint
backlog.nextStep: Construct full-schema concurrent creation/approval counterexample; inspect all constraints before classifying confirmed

backlog.title: Course and service quotes can round their required deposit to zero
backlog.evidence: calculateCoursePrice 1 0 CourseDeposit 1 and calculateBookingPrice 1 60 0 1 60 480 60 60 return zero payable; canonical runtime CHECK requires positive due_now_minor/deposit_minor
backlog.nextStep: Add boundary/property regressions and reject zero after rounding without increasing the agreed monetary amount

backlog.title: Legacy Stripe tickets remain issued while a refund outcome is uncertain
backlog.evidence: The legacy branch has no canonical per-ticket reservation or reconciliation exception
backlog.nextStep: Model admission and transfer while an outcome is held; preserve credentials and payment evidence through a qualified reconciliation path
